title: MV Make SRD's Metronome Skill not count as action taken

posts.author: FrozenFacade
posts.body:
I am using SRD's Metronome Skill plugin to call random effects that trigger based on a character performing specific actions... however the skill that triggers the metronome skill, the metronome trigger and the random skill that it calls all count as a turn ending... which means character's who activate this effect suffer poison or burn damage 3 times since it counts as if they performed 3 actions when it should ideally only happen once (the move they used to trigger the metronome effect).
I am using RPG maker MV and the Yanfly CTB battle system. (I tried using Yanfly's instant cast but it didn't seem to work with the CTB battle system at least for what I wanted it to do.)
For clarification the end of turn/action effects trigger 3 times, when I want them to only trigger once.
1st - When character performs skill that triggers common event (Poison/Burn etc triggers - OK)
2nd - Metronome common event forces metronome skill (Poison/Burn etc triggers - NOT OK)
3rd - Metronome skill happens (Poison/Burn etc triggers - NOT OK)
(I suppose this might not even relate to the SRD plugin, if there is just a way to program a skill to not count as if an action was taken that would also work since I could apply it to the metronome caller skill and the skills it can call)
